query: I just got back from walking my dog this morning and he stopped to chase a squirrel all the way across the park, I even had to run after him so he didn't run into the street. After that I popped into the neighborhood bakery and picked up a fresh chocolate croissant, it was still warm and flaky when I ate it on the walk home. I also remembered I need to pick up a new collar for him this weekend since his old one is starting to fray at the edges. Anyway, I need to return a delivered item from my order #W9502127, the item I want to return is 9534205511, and I'd like the refund to be sent to my paypal_2433177 payment method please.
